# Genesis Core Systems

> Genesis Core Systems delivers core banking to U.S. community banks. It packages a proven Tier-1-grade core foundation with Genesis-led configuration, integration, conversion and ongoing support. Based in New York, NY.

The platform provides real-time posting, a modular architecture and an open API layer, engineered for small and medium-sized community banks. A Design Partner Program lets a bank shape the platform while its current core stays the system of record until cutover readiness.

## Pages

- [Home](https://genesiscoresystems.com/): Overview of the Genesis Core Systems core banking platform for community banks.
- [Solutions](https://genesiscoresystems.com/solutions): The platform itself. Real-time processing, modular architecture, an open API layer, and modules for deposits, lending, payments, and onboarding.
- [Core Conversion Guide](https://genesiscoresystems.com/core-conversion): What a bank core conversion involves, how long it takes, what drives the cost, the phases from discovery through cutover and reconciliation, and where conversions go wrong.
- [Services](https://genesiscoresystems.com/services): Core conversion, implementation, and migration for community banks, sequenced from discovery through cutover and parallel run, plus support and training.
- [Partnership](https://genesiscoresystems.com/partnership): The Genesis Design Partner Program, limited-enrollment partnership for community banks.
- [About](https://genesiscoresystems.com/about): Genesis Core Systems is a core banking provider for U.S. community banks, based in New York, built by people who have run conversions and core operations.
- [Articles](https://genesiscoresystems.com/articles): Writing on core conversion, migration testing, and vendor contracts for community banks.
- [FAQ](https://genesiscoresystems.com/faq): Frequently asked questions about solutions, services, implementation, security, and the Design Partner Program.
- [Contact](https://genesiscoresystems.com/contact): Get in touch with the Genesis Core Systems team.

## Articles

- [What Is a Core Banking System?](https://genesiscoresystems.com/core-banking-system): A plain-language guide for community banks covering what a core banking system does, core banking vs. core processing, surround systems, batch vs. real-time posting, how to evaluate a core, what a core conversion involves, and modernization paths.
- [Modernizing the Community-Bank Core](https://genesiscoresystems.com/article-modernizing-community-bank-core): A Genesis perspective by Brent Jenos on why core banking modernization is hard for community banks and a practical, evidence-driven path forward, a managed program owned by one accountable operator.
- [Transforming Community Banking](https://genesiscoresystems.com/article-transforming-community-banking): A practical path to modern core banking for community banks.
